A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Amulet study, with readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A–E. All scientific content can be matched directly across the two versions.

before.justification: v1 reports original preference-alignment experiments, reward-model and GPT-4o evaluations, ablations, and computational timing measurements in Section 4 and Appendix B.

after.justification: v2 retains the original experimental results in Section 4 and Appendix B, including benchmark comparisons, ablations, and timing measurements.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithm 1 retain the same prompt-derived utility, KL regularization, FTRL-proximal optimization, and closed-form decoding updates.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same preference-alignment task on HelpSteer, Truthful QA, UltraChat, and Personal across eight preference dimensions. No datasets or test scenarios are added or removed.

E2.justification: The quality comparisons retain Base, Pref, BS16, and LA. Table 4 also retains RAIN and beam-search configurations with widths 4, 8, and 16 in the timing comparison.

E3.justification: Section 4 and Appendices B–C retain identical dataset sample counts, model configurations, evaluation metrics, parameter sweeps, and GPT-4o judging procedures.

E4.justification: The model-size and hyperparameter analyses in Section 4.3, additional iteration analyses and efficiency comparison in Appendix B, and case studies in Appendix D are unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same aggregate reward-score, win-rate, and Bradley–Terry reporting. No run-count, seed, uncertainty-estimation, or significance-testing information is added or removed.

E6.justification: Tables 1–4, Figures 2–12, and Appendix D retain identical numerical results and qualitative examples. For example, Table 1 still reports 0.62 for Amulet and 0.46 for LA on Llama-3.1-8B with Personal and the creative preference.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Proposition 3.1, and Appendix A's closed-form derivation and convergence lemmas and proof are identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about training-free personalized alignment through per-token online optimization, efficient closed-form updates, and empirical advantages.

C2.justification: Result interpretations and efficiency qualifications are unchanged. Appendix E retains the same limitations concerning model knowledge, responsiveness to preference prompts, and potential harmful uses.

D1.justification: The documented hyperparameters, data extraction procedures, implementation and hardware details in Appendix B.5, evaluation prompt and scoring instructions in Appendix C, and project link are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. The Turchin (2019) reference changes only the punctuation before its year, without changing the cited work.

P1.justification: v2 changes the BIGAI affiliation from National Key Laboratory to State Key Laboratory, adds an envelope/email link for Zilong Zheng, updates the arXiv version/date stamp, and adjusts punctuation in the Turchin reference. Scientific prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–12 and Tables 1–4 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. The document and appendix layouts are unchanged apart from incidental spacing associated with the title-page text edits.

improvement.justification: v2 makes only administrative and punctuation edits. The method, theoretical arguments, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and limitations remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices, yielding no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
